audit_items.proof_trace: The validateDataColumnSidecarsByRangeRequest function does not check if startSlot is within the serve range (minimum_request_epoch = max(current_epoch - MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS, FULU_FORK_EPOCH)). Line 134 has TODO comment confirming missing validation. The dataColumnSidecarsByRoot handler implements this check (lines 18-23, 48-50), proving this is unintentional omission.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends DataColumnSidecarsByRangeRequest with startSlot in epoch older than serve range. Request passes validation, handler attempts to serve or silently skips without proper ResourceUnavailable error, violating spec requirement and enabling potential resource exhaustion.
